derivationRules.componentContact: non-null qualifying operation=>addressed; null=>not-addressed; no propagation through graph edges
derivationRules.coverage: constructive=>not-applicable; responsive substituted=>substitution; preserved all components operated=>full; preserved some=>partial; preserved none plus cited relevant contrary material=>relevant-nonanswer; otherwise substitution
derivationRules.diagnostic: defectType != none AND defectEvidence present AND targetImpactExplicit true AND impactEvidence present
derivationRules.reframe: malformedDemandExplained true with evidence AND replacementDemandStated true with evidence
derivationRules.burdenRelation: null route=>unadopted-or-irrelevant; no bridge contact=>topical-peripheral; otherwise highest contacted tier motion=>completes, central=>advances-central, subsidiary=>advances-sub-burden
